sections.title: What it says its rows are

body.value: Which shops Contoso's store register marks as restructured — rebuilt or replaced, as against shut for good — one entry per set of premises so marked, named, with no figure attached and over the whole life of the register. Seven entries, six distinct names: 'Contoso Store New Brunswick' is listed TWICE because two successive sets of premises on that one site were each marked restructured, which is the succession-of-tenancies fact the Store/Location split exists to keep visible; counted as sites or as distinct names the list is six, and it is the same six names either way. NOT INCLUDED: the 9 premises marked 'Closed', the 57 rows with a blank status, and the online sentinel row, whose status is null. No restructuring date, type or reason — the bundle records none; the nearest fact is each premises' `close_date`, which runs 2013-12-05 to 2018-02-02 across these seven. Nothing was counted or summed, so there is no figure here to be right or wrong about — only this set of names.
